about.title: A League City shop that partners with Original Equipment Manufacturing companies
text: OEM Machining was established in 2009 and specializes in producing precision CNC components for Original Equipment Manufacturing companies in the Houston and surrounding areas.
Our mission is high quality parts at the best price, on time, consistently.
We aim to understand what matters to each customer and to meet or exceed our commitment.
